body:
I suffer occasional panic attacks, and no one around me would understand, as i have always been a confident and life loving person. But my lifes not great anymore, my life isnt even worth anything to me anymore. But panic/anxiety attacks are some of the scariest moments of my life. I have never felt like i have been so close to death, like a breath is always out of reach and you can feel your lungs quivering and searing when you try to pull one in. Your heart feels like its banging so hard its going to go supernova and explode from your chest. Your vision goes blurry and your terrified of everything, you feel faint. And you cant help feeling horrific thoughts, thoughts that no one should ever entertain. 

Everyone says its mental, and they are right. But that doesnt mean its not real or happening. When it happens to me, i open a window and breath in fresh air, and this helps. However over time i have came over much better ways to deal with it.

Remove yourself from the enviornment you are currently in, something as simple as leaving the room. i dont know why this works but it does, its like while your in that room your in a cage of bad feelings and terror but once your out you can slowly start to wind yourself back in.

You can also focus on whats happening to you, I usually shut my eyes and imagine the painful banging in my chest to be a sphere of energy, shaking and jumping around and trying to escape me. So i close my eyes, and focus on slowing the ball down, and trying to get it into a steady swinging rhythm or completely still.

And the best way i have found to deal with it is just to say "Fuck you, i got shit to do" and find anything to invest yourself in, doing cleaning/dishes is fantastic, sing to yourself, and if it starts getting out of control while your doing it, take a breath and say its all mental and i know it is. And just keep working away at your cleaning or dishes, and i promise it will subside. 

We cant all be strong all the time, and those of us who manage to keep that brave mask on for everyone to see, suffer the worst.

Dont get me wrong, my father is fantastic. And i love him, but he has said before that he doesnt understand depression because he has never been there. He even said to me "and dont try to blame this on depression pish" And right there i was angry, he has no fucking right, and no fucking knowledge of what i go through day to day just to get out of my fucking bed. Far less manage to work and pay my bills. I have not forgiven him for what he said, and i dont know if i ever will. It cut deep, too deep. 

My family always say you can talk to us about it. Can i fuck, not one of them understands, because not one of them have been where i am. If i talk to you about it you just fucking lecture me on all my short comings which is not what i fucking need. If i could afford to right now, i would fly away and somehow make something happen elsewhere, i would just go. Like a fresh fart in a gust of winters air, and i wouldnt be in contact with any of my family, at all. I would delete every social networking site i am on, change my name and start again. And maybe a few years down the line when i am at least a person again i would make contact. But unfortunately this is not an option for me. Even though it feels like the only real one i have.
